implementation.name: Pokemon Mini (Analogue Pocket, agg23)
implementation.notes: Source availability (T5.4): open -- the repository carries 34 HDL source files (20 systemverilog, 12 verilog, 2 vhdl). There is no open_source column in the delivered schema (data-model.md §1.9 deleted the proposed core table together with its flags); the presence of hdl_language_id and of implementation_path rows is how that fact is stated here. Machine mapping: hand-mapped, not setname-derived -- this core ships no MRA file. It reimplements the Nintendo Pokemon Mini, giving machine_id pokemini, each checked against extract/machine.json. license_id omitted: https://github.com/agg23/openfpga-pokemonmini/blob/master/LICENSE is the verbatim GNU GPL version 2 text, but the repository states no version scope, and GPL's only-vs-or-later distinction comes from the grant, not the licence text. hdl_language_id: no single HDL family reaches 90% of the 34 source files (20 systemverilog, 12 verilog, 2 vhdl), excluding the shared framework directory. accuracy_id omitted: the repository makes no timing-fidelity claim this build could verify. Core identity read from the openFPGA manifest dist/Cores/agg23.PokemonMini/core.json in the repository, which declares core identifier agg23.PokemonMini.
